head: 716b2b88
feature: TUIC v5 shared-endpoint multi-connection server and sing-box interop gate

commands.unit: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter="TUIC shared endpoint" --summary all

behavior: The TUIC server now runs on quic.endpoint_server.Server: one pump owns the UDP socket and every established connection, CID routing replaces the per-connection blocking receive, DNS/TCP connect work runs on two bounded worker threads, and TCP relays publish chunks through bounded queues with short partial-write turns. Two concurrent connections are covered by an in-repo test, and sing-box 1.14.4 verifies TCP plus SOCKS5 UDP associate in both native DATAGRAM and QUIC uni-stream UDP relay modes.
conclusion: The TUIC multi-connection gate is green against an independent client. Hysteria v3 still uses the older blocking receive shape and needs the same port before it can claim an equivalent gate.
